headline: Dynamic social cards, motion design overhaul, DEWS radar redesign, and mint/burn flows rebuilt on Alchemy.
fieldNotes: The week's work split between presentation and plumbing. Satori-rendered social cards and a homepage motion pass changed how pages look when shared and loaded, and the DEWS radar was inverted so danger sits at the center. Underneath, mint/burn scanning moved from Etherscan to Alchemy and expanded to the top 50 Ethereum coins, and every stablecoin ID moved to the canonical ticker-issuer format in a four-phase migration with redirects.

summary.label: Dynamic OG images
summary.description: Worker-generated social cards with Satori + resvg-wasm for stablecoin, safety, depeg, and PSI pages with one-click sharing

summary.label: Homepage motion design
summary.description: Entrance choreography, animated counters, grade badge pop, chart draw-in, contagion ripple, and intelligence briefing module

summary.label: DEWS radar redesign
summary.description: Inverted radar with animated sweep line, interactive coin dots, hover tooltips, and Telegram alerts for band transitions

summary.label: Mint/burn flows overhaul
summary.description: Alchemy JSON-RPC migration, expanded to top-50 Ethereum coins, BRRRR deck hero, flow signals strip, and 30/90d net columns

summary.label: Ticker-issuer ID migration
summary.description: Four-phase migration to canonical IDs across all stablecoins with portfolio migration, URL redirects, and DL remapping

summary.label: Worker hardening
summary.description: Circuit breakers, AbortSignal cron timeouts, D1 retry logic, 100+ new worker tests, and degraded-mode pipeline handling

summary.label: Expanded coverage
summary.description: USTB, OUSG, USCC, mTBILL, XMMF, USD+, wsrUSD, ebUSD, USND, USDaf added to tracking with reserves and AI summaries

summary.label: Methodology versioning
summary.description: Version tracking and changelogs surfaced for PSI, PegScore/DEWS, Liquidity Score, blacklist, and mint/burn flows
